title: Synthetic Logic: decades fused into a system with AI, and cognitive debt in the owner's own foundational work (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
[…] when I look at my output. (/home/greenman/Dropbox/enough/syntheticlogic.md) it is mine and it's also not. I let the AI own the wrong parts. I was not in charge of myself.

[…] this synthetic logic, was the beginning. It was the moment I was able to fuse decades of my work into a system. And I may never have reached it without AI. 

But, I need to go back to it, and rewrite it all because the words are not properly mine. And some I may not even recognise. There is cognitive debt... in my own foundational work
